rule: argmax(log(max(probability, float64_tiny)) + exponent * log(full_fit_class_prior)); exponent zero is exact raw argmax
calibration_membership: Exclude exact 37-feature matches to the entire fitting partition, then exclude matches to the fixed audit partition. Label-blind exclusions from calibration only; no reassignment or audit change.
selection: One rule shared by all three seeds. Every seed must improve macro-F1 and both rare-class F1 values, with benign false-alert rate no higher than the same-seed raw sqrt baseline. Maximize mean rare F1, then mean macro-F1, then declared method/exponent order.
audit: Freeze selection before new audit scoring. Score only raw baseline, raw equal-class bridge, and selected rule. Never select on audit or evaluate the remaining adjusted candidates there.
stopping_rule: If no rule passes calibration or the selected rule fails the audit screen, retain raw sqrt baseline and close this bounded decision-rule search; do not expand the grid.
